starter_questions: Can I start with the synthetic startup packets?
How should I organize documents for my own companies?
Which claim or scoring assumption needs more diligence?

setup_guide.introduction: I'll review startup evidence, explain seven screening methods and surface diligence questions for your investment review. The bundled startup packets are synthetic; real screening needs an approved document folder, preferably one subfolder per company. You'll get company reports with sources and gaps, not an investment decision or founder outreach.

sample.title: Synthetic startup screening
sample.description: Review bundled synthetic startup packets with the normal screening workflow. Public research may be incomplete; sample companies are not real opportunities.
sample.expected_output: After sample screening completes, company reports with explanations of the seven methods, dated sources, warnings and open diligence questions.

real.introduction: Choose the approved startup-document folder and output location, preferably with one subfolder per company. I’ll prepare company screening reports with dated sources, method explanations and diligence gaps.

fields.label: Document folder
fields.description: Local folder monitored for startup documents; first-level folders are treated as companies.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Local folder where per-company reports and the company index should be written.
